english.title: Superintendent registrar issue certificate for marriage before 28 days after marriage entered in notice book
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a superintendent registrar, knowingly and wilfully issued a certificate for the marriage of **(..SPECIFY THE PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..) before **(..SPECIFY DATE OF EXPIRY..), being the date of expiry of 28 days from the day on which the notice of marriage was entered in

(A)_[the marriage notice book]_
(B)_[an approved electronic form by virtue of section 27(4A) of the Marriage Act 1949]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(3)(a) of the Marriage Act 1949.

english.notes: The term 'certificates of a superintendent registrar' is substituted by a 'marriage schedule' from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/411). For offences which occur from this date, please see H22868.

other.penalty:
